_what: Verbatim NCBI RefSeq (GRCh38) promoter cache for the psychiatric risk-gene atlas. Each entry's gamma is computed by the locked SantaLucia-1998 NN metric over [TSS-2000, TSS+500] = 2501 bp coding strand. The raw promoter sequence is stored so gamma is RE-DERIVABLE OFFLINE and the sha256 proves the exact sequence used (C1 reproduction path stays inside the package).
